items.name: smooth-shadow
items.title: Shadow Elevation System
items.description: Six stacked shadow depths with optional integrated hairline rings, independent shadow and ring tinting, and automatic light and dark ring values.
items.author: Florian Kiem and collaborators; adapted for Kit by Scott E. Telling

items.docs: Use smooth-shadow-{size} for ringless depth or smooth-shadow-ring-{size} for an elevated surface with its hairline edge already included. Do not add a separate border or ring to the same elevated element. Original work: https://shadow.floriankiem.com (MIT).
